description: A modern flat-screen television is displayed against a gradient gray background. The screen showcases a vibrant, close-up image of bright orange flower petals, possibly from a chrysanthemum or dahlia. The television has a slim black bezel and rests on two thin black legs. A small red indicator light is visible on the bottom center of the frame, and a white cable is plugged into the right side of the TV, extending downwards. The overall presentation is clean and contemporary, emphasizing the visual content on the screen.
